key: Doubting me, of all people? You've got some nerve!
en: Doubting me, of all people? You've got some nerve!
ja: よりによって、このオレを疑うのか? いい度胸だな!

key: I'll bend your body so in-half that you're stuck in a bowing position for the rest of your life!
en: I'll bend your body so in-half that you're stuck in a bowing position for the rest of your life!
ja: お前の体をぐいっと折り曲げて、一生お辞儀したままの姿勢にしてやるぞ!

key: Oh, you wanna take me on too!?
en: Oh, you wanna take me on too!?
ja: おっ、お前もオレに挑む気か!?

key: Unbreaking spirit!
en: Unbreaking spirit!
ja: 折れぬ心!

key: \PN won a bonus!
en: \PN won a bonus!
ja: \PNはボーナスを獲得した!

key: I can still keep going!!!
en: I can still keep going!!!
ja: まだまだ行けるぞ!!!

key: You're still two thousand lightyears away from me!
en: You're still two thousand lightyears away from me!
ja: お前なんて、オレにはまだ二千光年も及ばないんだよ!

key: When you and I face each other like this, we are one in both body and mind.
en: When you and I face each other like this, we are one in both body and mind.
ja: こうして向き合えば、お前とオレは心も体もひとつになる。

key: I can easily see what you're thinking!
en: I can easily see what you're thinking!
ja: お前の考えなんて、簡単にお見通しだ!

key: Ho-- A new challenger appears?!
en: Ho-- A new challenger appears?!
ja: ほう――新たな挑戦者の登場か!?

key: Do you dare face me!?
en: Do you dare face me!?
ja: このオレに挑む勇気があるのか!?

key: Unflinching power!
en: Unflinching power!
ja: ひるまぬ力!

key: I will never stop fighting!!!
en: I will never stop fighting!!!
ja: オレは戦いをやめない!!!

key: Hah! Cower in your lack of power!
en: Hah! Cower in your lack of power!
ja: はっ! 力のなさに震え上がるがいい!

key: This place really emptied out when...
en: This place really emptied out when...
ja: この場所、本当に人がいなくなったよな、あの時から……

key: Well, you know.
en: Well, you know.
ja: まあ、わかるだろ。

key: But for those of us that are still here, it's just proof that we will never, ever bow out.
en: But for those of us that are still here, it's just proof that we will never, ever bow out.
ja: でも、まだここに残ってるオレたちにとっては、それこそが絶対に引き下がらないって証なんだ。

key: Willpower is putting one foot in front of the other, every day, even when it's the absolute last thing you want to do.
en: Willpower is putting one foot in front of the other, every day, even when it's the absolute last thing you want to do.
ja: 意志の力ってのは、たとえそれが一番やりたくないことでも、毎日一歩ずつ前に進み続けることだ。

key: That's what Victoria taught me.
en: That's what Victoria taught me.
ja: それが、ヴィクトリアがオレに教えてくれたことなんだ。

key: Let's show Kiki just how strong our willpower is!
en: Let's show Kiki just how strong our willpower is!
ja: オレたちの意志の力がどれだけ強いか、キキに見せてやろうぜ!

key: VICTORIA: Everyone can see this bowl, right?
en: VICTORIA: Everyone can see this bowl, right?
ja: ヴィクトリア：みなさん、このボウルが見えますね?

key: So, I'm going to put some rocks into this bowl.
en: So, I'm going to put some rocks into this bowl.
ja: では、このボウルに石をいくつか入れていきます。

key: VICTORIA: ...There, that should do it.
en: VICTORIA: ...There, that should do it.
ja: ヴィクトリア：……はい、これでよいでしょう。

key: Does anyone think I can fit more into the bowl?
en: Does anyone think I can fit more into the bowl?
ja: これ以上、まだ入ると思う人はいますか?

key: VICTORIA: ...Anyone?
en: VICTORIA: ...Anyone?
ja: ヴィクトリア：……誰かいますか?

key: HIKER: Looks full to me.
en: HIKER: Looks full to me.
ja: やまおとこ：もういっぱいに見えるけど。

key: BLACKBELT: Yeah, no way.
en: BLACKBELT: Yeah, no way.
ja: からておう：ああ、無理だろ。

key: VICTORIA: Right.
en: VICTORIA: Right.
ja: ヴィクトリア：そうですね。

key: Except...
en: Except...
ja: ただし……

key: Say, rather than rocks, I now fill it with sand...
en: Say, rather than rocks, I now fill it with sand...
ja: たとえば、石の代わりに砂を入れてみると……

key: VICTORIA: ...There was quite a bit of room in there after all, wasn't there?
en: VICTORIA: ...There was quite a bit of room in there after all, wasn't there?
ja: ヴィクトリア：……やっぱり、思ったよりもすき間があったでしょう?

key: HIKER: I, uh, assumed you meant rocks...
en: HIKER: I, uh, assumed you meant rocks...
ja: やまおとこ：てっきり石のことだと思って……

key: VICTORIA: Gotcha~
en: VICTORIA: Gotcha~
ja: ヴィクトリア：ひっかかりましたね~

key: But, now-- I mean, it's packed to the brim.
en: But, now-- I mean, it's packed to the brim.
ja: でも、今度こそ――もう、ふちまでぎっしりです。

key: There's no way anything else will fit into it, right?
en: There's no way anything else will fit into it, right?
ja: これ以上は何も入らないはずですよね?

key: YOUNGSTER: No...?
en: YOUNGSTER: No...?
ja: たんぱんこぞう：無理、じゃない……?

key: NATURE GIRL: It's full.
en: NATURE GIRL: It's full.
ja: ネイチャーガール：いっぱいだよ。

key: VICTORIA: Tsk, tsk, tsk.
en: VICTORIA: Tsk, tsk, tsk.
ja: ヴィクトリア：ちっ、ちっ、ちっ。

key: But what if I were now to pour some water into the bowl?
en: But what if I were now to pour some water into the bowl?
ja: では、ここに水を注いでみたらどうなるでしょう?

key: NATURE GIRL: Okay, that's cheating.
en: NATURE GIRL: Okay, that's cheating.
ja: ネイチャーガール：それはずるいよ。

key: VICTORIA: Perhaps,
en: VICTORIA: Perhaps,
ja: ヴィクトリア：そうかもしれません。

key: But then, who is making the rules?
en: But then, who is making the rules?
ja: でも、ルールを決めているのは誰でしょうか?

key: Now let's do something else.
en: Now let's do something else.
ja: では、次のことをしてみましょう。

key: First, I'll empty the bowl; we're starting over...
en: First, I'll empty the bowl; we're starting over...
ja: まずボウルを空にして、最初からやり直します……

key: VICTORIA: Okay, now as you can see, I've filled the bowl with sand from the get-go.
en: VICTORIA: Okay, now as you can see, I've filled the bowl with sand from the get-go.
ja: ヴィクトリア：さて、ご覧の通り、最初から砂でボウルを満たしました。

key: Can I fit any rocks into this bowl?
en: Can I fit any rocks into this bowl?
ja: このボウルに石を入れられるでしょうか?

key: HIKER: If it's specifically rocks, no. Surely not.
en: HIKER: If it's specifically rocks, no. Surely not.
ja: やまおとこ：石限定なら、無理だろ。絶対に。

key: VICTORIA: Correct.
en: VICTORIA: Correct.
ja: ヴィクトリア：その通りです。

key: When we start with the rocks, there's room for the sand.
en: When we start with the rocks, there's room for the sand.
ja: 石から始めれば、砂の入るすき間があります。

key: When we start with the sand, there's no room for rocks.
en: When we start with the sand, there's no room for rocks.
ja: 砂から始めれば、石の入るすき間はありません。

key: You can think of the sand as our everyday responsibilities.
en: You can think of the sand as our everyday responsibilities.
ja: 砂は、わたしたちの日々の義務だと考えてください。

key: Work, house chores, and so on.
en: Work, house chores, and so on.
ja: 仕事や家事など、そういったものです。

key: If we prioritize them, we have no room for other things.
en: If we prioritize them, we have no room for other things.
ja: それらを優先すれば、他のもののための余地はなくなります。

key: But if we prioritize the rocks, which we can think of as things we truly enjoy-- our passions and aspirations...
en: But if we prioritize the rocks, which we can think of as things we truly enjoy-- our passions and aspirations...
ja: でも、石――つまり本当に楽しいと思えるもの、情熱や夢を優先すれば……

key: Well, the sand finds a way regardless, doesn't it?
en: Well, the sand finds a way regardless, doesn't it?
ja: それでも、砂はちゃんと入る場所を見つけるものでしょう?

key: YOUNGSTER: What about the water?
en: YOUNGSTER: What about the water?
ja: たんぱんこぞう：じゃあ、水は?

key: VICTORIA: The water...
en: VICTORIA: The water...
ja: ヴィクトリア：水は……

key: I prefer to think of it as the people we care about.
en: I prefer to think of it as the people we care about.
ja: わたしたちが大切にしている人たちだと考えるのが好きです。

key: There's always room for them.
en: There's always room for them.
ja: 彼らのための場所は、いつだってあるのです。

key: RANGER: Excuse me?
en: RANGER: Excuse me?
ja: ポケモンレンジャー：すみません?

key: VICTORIA: How can we help you?
en: VICTORIA: How can we help you?
ja: ヴィクトリア：何かご用でしょうか?

key: RANGER: We're from the Johto Region...
en: RANGER: We're from the Johto Region...
ja: ポケモンレンジャー：わたしたち、ジョウト地方から来たんですが……

key: Er, we heard something about some kind of famous spiritual counselor out here?
en: Er, we heard something about some kind of famous spiritual counselor out here?
ja: ええと、こちらに有名な精神カウンセラーがいると聞いたもので。

key: We were hoping to study with her.
en: We were hoping to study with her.
ja: 彼女のもとで学びたいと思っていたんです。

key: VICTORIA: ...Ah, I'm sorry.
en: VICTORIA: ...Ah, I'm sorry.
ja: ヴィクトリア：……ああ、申し訳ありません。

key: If you mean Kiki, I'm afraid she's no longer with us.
en: If you mean Kiki, I'm afraid she's no longer with us.
ja: キキのことでしたら、残念ながら彼女はもうこの世にはいません。

key: RANGER: No, no, no that ain't it--
en: RANGER: No, no, no that ain't it--
ja: ポケモンレンジャー：いえ、いえ、そうじゃなくて――

key: Her name was, uh, Victoria?
en: Her name was, uh, Victoria?
ja: 名前は、ええと、ヴィクトリアさんだったかと?

key: VICTORIA: ...Oh?
en: VICTORIA: ...Oh?
ja: ヴィクトリア：……あら?
……あら!

key: Yes, that would be me.
en: Yes, that would be me.
ja: はい、それはわたしのことです。

key: Please, take a seat; you're very welcome!
en: Please, take a seat; you're very welcome!
ja: どうぞお座りください、大歓迎ですよ!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
